chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on accelerating diffusion-based Large Language Models (dLLMs) which operate by iteratively denoising masked segments, fitting the definition of Masked Diffusion Models.
The paper discusses the integration of autoregressive-style caching techniques (prompt caching) within the diffusion inference process, bridging the gap between AR and diffusion paradigms.

The proposed dLLM-Cache relies on analyzing the similarity of intermediate feature representations across denoising steps to reuse computations, which relates to the theory of information flow in iterative models.
